Welcome to the **Exploring eDNA in SBDI** workshop at [BioSyst EU 2026](https://www.biosyst.eu/2026){target="_blank"}, Uppsala, 17–19 August 2026! This workshop demonstrates how eDNA/metabarcoding data can be accessed, processed and analysed within the [Swedish Biodiversity Data Infrastructure (SBDI)](https://biodiversitydata.se/){target="_blank"} — from data submission and processing through to exploring arthropod biodiversity patterns across Swedish habitat types, using COI metabarcoding data from the [Insect Biome Atlas](https://www.insectbiomeatlas.org/){target="_blank"}.

## Agenda

- **Introduction: SBDI's eDNA tools and workflows** (15 min)
  - From raw reads to ASVs: ENA submission, denoising with nf-core/ampliseq, the ASV portal and asvoccur
  - [Download slides (PDF)](slides-intro.pdf){target="_blank"}<br><br>

- **Hands-on tutorial: Import and analyse ASV portal data with R** (1 h)
  - Integrate ASV portal data with asvoccur
  - Explore arthropod biodiversity patterns across habitat types

## Instructors
- Dr. Maria Prager — SBDI & University of Gothenburg
- Dr. Tobias Andermann — SBDI & Uppsala University
